jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.description: Role Description: You will help build and deploy Haladir’s products end to end. The stack spans data infrastructure and integrations with the systems operators already use, including WMS, TMS, and OMS, through the decisioning layer and the interfaces warehouse teams use every day. You will ship across frontend and backend, potentially spend time at operator sites understanding how decisions are actually made on the floor, and turn those operational constraints into product. We move quickly, and AI coding tools are a core part of how we build. We expect you to use them deeply and effectively. Required Qualifications: - Exceptional full-stack engineer who can own a problem end to end, from schema to interface - Uses AI coding tools as a core part of their development workflow and has shipped meaningful production software with them - Fast and efficient without sacrificing correctness, with strong judgment on what to build and what to skip - Strong product sense and the ability to turn an operator conversation into a product decision without needing a detailed spec - Willingness to relocate to San Francisco and travel to potential customer sites - US work authorization Preferred Qualifications: - Currently enrolled or finished Bachelor's degree - Early-stage startup experience - Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as WMS, TMS, ERP, or OMS - Experience with optimization algorithms, operations research, or decision-making systems

jobs.title: Founding Operations Research Engineer (Full Time)
jobs.description: Role Description: You will aid in designing the optimization core of Haladir’s products, including, for example, the models that decide how waves get released, how inventory gets allocated, how routing occurs within trucking networks, and/or how labor gets planned inside 3PL operations. Our approach combines practical heuristics, including local search and hill climbing, with solver-based methods such as MILP and constraint programming where they are the right tool. You will take messy operational constraints and turn them into formulations and systems that run in production under real-world deadlines. You will work closely with operator's problems to understand how decisions are actually made, determine what should be optimized, and build models that can make those decisions reliably at scale. This role offers greater autonomy and closer collaboration with the founding team than other positions. Required Qualifications: - Strong background in Operations Research, including MILP, constraint programming, heuristics, and local search - Research experience in Operations Research through publications, graduate research, or equivalent applied work - Able to implement your own models in production-quality Python using solver APIs such as Gurobi, CP-SAT, or HiGHS - Able to turn real-world operational constraints into mathematical models that can run in production - Strong judgment around solution quality, computational performance, and real-world operational constraints - Willingness to relocate to San Francisco and travel to potential customer sites - US work authorization Preferred Qualifications: - Currently enrolled or finished MS or PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field - Domain experience in warehousing, routing, scheduling, or supply chain - Experience deploying optimization models in live operational environments
